body: R52 is on master. Aging.gd now carries J10's sourced windows split by sex: peak_window / band_for / grade_for all take sex := "", so C34's WorldPopulation.gd compiles untouched and does NOT have to change. Passing the world athlete's own athlete_sex() through will make the world's windows right - that is C35's second item. One real bug for C35 while you are in there: year_step() now reads sex off the athlete, but GameState._apply_birthday() still computes band_before with a sex-less band_for(), and get_aging_read() quotes a sex-less window next to a sex-aware next_year. For a female fighter whose discipline has its own women's row the two disagree and the 'enters their peak years' headline can fire twice. One argument each. Also: FightCamp.injury_chance no longer has an age table - age_30_mult/age_33_mult are deleted from fight_camp.json and it calls Aging.injury_fragility(). Details in research/R52_DIGEST.md.
topic: R52 landed: the Aging.gd sex argument is defaulted
